questions.text: The diagram above shows a cuboid cut at the bottom a semicircle of radius 14cm. What is the volume of the structure? (Let value of π approximates to $\frac{22}{7}$)
questions.explanation: Volume of cuboid = 35 * 15 * 18 = 9450 cm^3. Volume of semicircular cut-out = (1/2) * π * r^2 \cdot length = (1/2) * ($\frac{22}{7}$) * 14^2 \cdot 13 = 3990 cm^3. Remaining volume = 9450 - 3990 = 5460 cm^3.

questions.title: Câu 3: There are 3 buses that can go between town A and town B, 5 b
questions.text: There are 3 buses that can go between town A and town B, 5 buses that go between town B and town C, and 4 buses that go from town C to town A (the bus cannot go from town A to town C). How many ways are there to go from town A to town C, then go back to town A again?
questions.explanation: Ways from town A to town C (via town B) = 3 * 5 = 15 ways. Ways from town C back to town A = 4 ways. Total ways = 15 * 4 = 60 ways.

questions.title: Câu 5: A rabbit and tortoise are having a 120m race on a straight t
questions.text: A rabbit and tortoise are having a 120m race on a straight track. The rabbit runs at 5m/min while the tortoise at 1m/min. After the rabbit reaches halfway of the track, it decides to take a rest. How long can the rabbit rest but still reach finish the race at the same time as the tortoise?
questions.explanation: Tortoise total time = 120 m / (1 m/min) = 120 minutes. Rabbit running time = 120 m / (5 m/min) = 24 minutes. Maximum resting time for rabbit = 120 - 24 = 96 minutes.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!

questions.text: Below shows a five letter combination made from 4 alphabets, 'A', 'B', 'C' and 2 'O's. How many ways are there to arrange these 5 letters such that the two 'O's are not beside each other?
questions.explanation: Total distinct permutations of A, B, C, O, O = 5! / 2! = 60. Permutations where the two 'O's are together (treating 'OO' as one unit) = 4! = 24. Arrangements where the two 'O's are not beside each other = 60 - 24 = 36.

questions.text: Jessica bought a TV with 30% of her money, an iPhone with 30% of the remaining money, and then a washing machine with 50% of the money left. She is left with RM980. How much money did she have?
questions.explanation: Fraction of money remaining = (1 - 0.30) * (1 - 0.30) * (1 - 0.50) = 0.70 * 0.70 * 0.50 = 0.245. Total original money = RM 980 / 0.245 = RM 4000.

questions.title: Câu 15: The weight of a jar filled fully with water is 2 times the w
questions.text: The weight of a jar filled fully with water is 2 times the weight of the same jar filled with 1/3 of water. What is the ratio of the weight of the jar without water to the weight of the jar filled fully with water?
questions.explanation: Let J = weight of jar, W = weight of full water. J + W = 2(J + W/3) = 2J + (2/3)W -> J = (1/3)W -> W = 3J. Total full weight = J + 3J = 4J. Ratio of empty jar to fully filled jar = J / (4J) = 1/4.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy quan sát vị trí của kim ngắn (chỉ giờ) và kim dài (chỉ phút) trên mặt đồng hồ để đọc thời gian chính xác nhé!

questions.text: In a large bag, there are 4 red balls, 5 blue balls, 6 green balls and 7 yellow balls. If 4 balls are taken out, what is the probability of getting 1 ball of every colour?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 = 22. Total ways to choose 4 balls = C(22, 4) = 7315. Ways to choose 1 of each color = 4 * 5 * 6 * 7 = 840. Probability = 840 / 7315 = 24/209.

questions.text: Maria is cutting cakes for her 22 students. If she can only cut the cakes vertically, what is the minimum number of cut to slice the cake into 22 pieces (regardless of the size of the cake)?

questions.text: A natural number has exactly three prime factors: 2, 3, and 5. The number is divisible by 6, 8, 10, and 12. What is the least such natural number?
questions.explanation: To be divisible by 8 (2^3), 12 (2^2 \cdot 3), and 10 (2 \cdot 5), the number must have at least 2^3, 3^1, and 5^1. Least number = 2^3 * 3 * 5 = 8 * 3 * 5 = 120.
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!

questions.text: A square has perimeter 32 cm. If the square is cut into four identical smaller squares, what is the side length of each smaller square?

questions.title: Câu: Tìm số nguyên dương thỏa mãn điều kiện chia hết #2131
questions.text:
Find the smallest positive integer $N$ that leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 3, 4, and 5.
(Tìm số nguyên dương $N$ nhỏ nhất chia cho 3, 4 và 5 đều dư 2.)
questions.explanation:
Vì $N$ chia cho 3, 4, 5 đều dư 2 nên $N - 2$ là bội chung của 3, 4, 5.
BCNN(3, 4, 5) = $3 \times 4 \times 5 = 60$.
Do đó số nguyên dương $N$ nhỏ nhất là $60 + 2 = 62$.
➔ Đáp án đúng là: **A. 62 \cdot *

questions.title: Câu 8: Four volunteers can pack 13 boxes every 15 minutes. How many
questions.text: Four volunteers can pack 13 boxes every 15 minutes. How many additional volunteers are needed to pack 260 boxes every hour? [Assume all volunteers work at the same rate.]
questions.explanation: 4 volunteers pack 13 * 4 = 52 boxes per hour (rate = 13 boxes/person/hour). To pack 260 boxes in an hour, total volunteers needed = 260 / 13 = 20 volunteers. Additional volunteers needed = 20 - 4 = 16.

questions.text: What is the least prime number that is the sum of 3 different prime numbers?

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 16: Judy has two more sisters than she has brothers. Her brother
questions.text: Judy has two more sisters than she has brothers. Her brother, Mark, has twice as many sisters as he has brothers. How many children are in their family?
questions.explanation: Let b = number of boys, g = number of girls. Judy has g - 1 sisters and b brothers: (g - 1) - b = 2 -> g - b = 3. Mark has g sisters and b - 1 brothers: g = 2(b - 1) -> g = 2b - 2. Substituting: 2b - 2 - b = 3 -> b = 5? Wait, g = 5, b = 2 gives: Judy has 4 sisters and 2 brothers (4 - 2 = 2); Mark has 5 sisters and 1 brother (5 = 2 \cdot 1? No, 2 \cdot (2-1) = 2, wait). If g=4, b=1: Mark has 0 brothers, g=4. If b=3, g=6: total = 7 children (g=4, b=3: total 7).
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Câu 20: Lara starts at the bottom of a long staircase. She climbs ex
questions.text: Lara starts at the bottom of a long staircase. She climbs exactly 2/3 of the stairs. Then, she goes back down exactly 1/2 of the way to the bottom. From that spot, she climbs exactly 2/3 of the way to the top. Finally, from there, she climbs 6 stairs to reach the top. How many stairs are in the staircase?
questions.explanation: Let S be the total stairs. Climbs 2/3 S. Goes down 1/2 way to bottom: position = (2/3 S) / 2 = 1/3 S. Climbs 2/3 of way to top: climbs (2/3)*(S - 1/3 S) = (2/3)*(2/3 S) = 4/9 S. New position = 1/3 S + 4/9 S = 7/9 S. Remaining stairs to top = S - 7/9 S = 2/9 S = 6 -> S = 6 * 9 / 2 = 27 (or 54).
questions.meeHint: Mèo Mee gợi ý: Con hãy tìm quy luật khoảng cách hoặc tỉ số giữa các số hạng liên tiếp trong dãy số để xác định số còn thiếu nhé!

explanationSteps.description: Let S be the total stairs. Climbs 2/3 S. Goes down 1/2 way to bottom: position = (2/3 S) / 2 = 1/3 S. questions.title: Câu 22: Find the whole number value of n such that $\frac{3}{80} < \frac{1}{n} < \frac{4}{101}$
questions.text:
Find the whole number value of n such that $\frac{3}{80} < \frac{1}{n} < \frac{4}{101}$.
(Tìm số nguyên dương n thoả mãn $\frac{3}{80} < \frac{1}{n} < \frac{4}{101}$.)
questions.explanation:
Nghịch đảo các phân số (đổi chiều bất đẳng thức):
$$\frac{80}{3} > n > \frac{101}{4} \iff 26.67 > n > 25.25$$
Vì $n$ là số nguyên dương nên giá trị duy nhất thỏa mãn là $n = 26$.
➔ Đáp án đúng là: **A. 26**

questions.title: Câu 25: The whole numbers from 1 to 2013 are written down on the bla
questions.text: The whole numbers from 1 to 2013 are written down on the blackboard. Tom underlined all numbers divisible by 2, then all numbers divisible by 3, and then all numbers divisible by 4. How many numbers are underlined precisely twice?
questions.explanation: A number is underlined twice if it is divisible by (2 and 3 but not 4) -> multiples of 6 not divisible by 12: floor(2013/6) - floor(2013/12) = 335 - 167 = 168. Or divisible by (2 and 4 but not 3) -> multiples of 4 not divisible by 12: floor(2013/4) - floor(2013/12) = 503 - 167 = 336. Total underlined twice = 168 + 336 = 504 (or 419 taking intersection logic).

questions.text: Susan has three stickers for every two stickers that Edward has. If Susan gives Edward 16 of her stickers, then Edward will have twice as many stickers as Susan has. Find the number of stickers Edward and Susan have all together.
questions.explanation: Let Susan = 3x, Edward = 2x. Total = 5x. After giving 16 stickers: 2(3x - 16) = 2x + 16 -> 6x - 32 = 2x + 16 -> 4x = 48 -> x = 12. Total stickers = 5 * 12 = 60.

questions.text: Kelly was elected club treasurer. She received 3 votes for every 2 that Ethan got. No one else ran. However, if 8 of the students who voted for Kelly had voted for Ethan instead, Kelly would have received only 1 vote for every 2 that Ethan would have gotten. questions.explanation: Let Kelly = 3x, Ethan = 2x, Total = 5x. After 8 switch votes: 2(3x - 8) = 2x + 8 -> 6x - 16 = 2x + 8 -> 4x = 24 -> x = 6. Total voters = 5 * 6 = 30.

questions.text: Charlie wants to cover the outside of a rectangular box with colored paper. The box has a square base with area of 16 square centimeters. questions.text: Using this staircase of 1-unit cubes, how many more 1-unit cubes will need to make a cube measuring 5 units on each side?
questions.explanation: Number of cubes in the 5-step staircase = 5 * (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5) = 5 * 15 = 75 cubes. Cubes in a 5x5x5 cube = 125. Additional cubes needed = 125 - 75 = 50 cubes.

questions.text: The digits 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 are each used once to write a five-digit number PQRST. The three-digit number PQR is divisible by 4, QRS is divisible by 5, and RST is divisible by 3. Determine the five-digit number PQRST.
questions.explanation: QRS divisible by 5 requires S = 5. QR divisible by 4 with digits from {1, 2, 3, 4} gives QR = 24. Then RST = 45T must be divisible by 3 -> 4 + 5 + T = 9 + T is div by 3 -> T = 3. Remaining digit is P = 1. Number is PQRST = 12453.

questions.text:
During photosynthesis, what gas do green plants absorb from the atmosphere and what gas do they release?
